new_value: {"notes":"Implemented an authenticated crash-safe Zephyr Settings/NVS adapter in new coap_keys_settings source/header and clean CMake wiring. The backend stores compact fixed-width entry records in two revision-parity generations, invalidates the inactive metadata marker first, authenticates metadata+ordered entries with keyed BLAKE2b, and commits metadata last. Load strictly validates names, sizes, magic/version/count/parity/tag, selects the highest valid revision, and rejects a revision below the caller-supplied trusted monotonic floor. Explicit init idempotently starts Settings before binding the generic durable key store; the required 32-byte key is documented as device-secret material. Focused deterministic fake-Settings tests compile and cover authenticated reboot restore, mid-save power loss fallback, data corruption, wrong key, rollback floor, committed empty/delete generation, and load errors. nRF52840 Zephyr configuration with Settings+NVS succeeded; app test TU, backend TU, and production no-test-hooks backend TU compile cleanly with no leaf-local warnings; git diff --check passes. Full image linking remains outside this leaf due existing dirty coap_keys.c implicit OSCORE/IID declarations plus Zephyr 4.1 header Werror diagnostics."}
